_comment: REFERENCE config for the autonomous cadence. The EXECUTABLE runner that turns this into reality now lives in deploy/ (run-machine.sh + crontab.example + telegram-notify.sh). Two ways to run it: EITHER the harness `/loop` skill (e.g. `/loop weekly /weekly-ops`) OR a VPS cron via deploy/crontab.example calling deploy/run-machine.sh. This file stays the single source of truth for the intended schedule + alerts. See deploy/README.md for the step-by-step wiring runbook.

loops.name: dm-poll
loops._note: Every 5 min — only works with an always-on host (the DM webhook needs to be reachable too).

telegram._note: deploy/telegram-notify.sh sends the alerts; run-machine.sh calls it on every run's success/failure. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in deploy/.env to activate. Mirrors Romain's Telegram failure alerts.
